evidence: Modifies core validation interfaces in src/validation.cpp, src/validation.h, and src/consensus/validation.h.
rationale: Refactoring validation methods to return BlockValidationState by value removes an error-prone pattern where return booleans and output states could diverge or pollute state across chained calls. While beneficial for code safety, it is an internal interface modernization with no immediate user-facing or consensus behavioral changes, making review worthwhile but deferrable.
